name: 71360 · Pineville, LA
findings: ZIP 71360 (Pineville) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71360 (Pineville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 71360 (Pineville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
